figures.finding: Luxembourg's directors and screenwriters are represented by LARS (founded 1999, some 50 members, a member of FERA and FSE); membership requires a directing or writing credit on a released and publicly screened feature, TV programme or short produced in Luxembourg. No fee schedule is published.

value.joins: a directing or writing credit on a commercially released, publicly screened feature, TV programme or short, produced (ideally funded) in Luxembourg

sources.said: The Luxembourgish Association of Filmmakers and Scriptwriters (LARS) is a non-profit association founded in 1999. Our 50 members include the vast majority of professional directors and scriptwriters active in Luxembourg.
Membership requires a directing or writing credit on a commercially released and publicly screened feature film, TV program or short film, produced and ideally funded in Luxembourg.
